unit.why: A single anecdote: a man rumored to be forbidden to his wife and childless due to a genital defect visits the Maggid, who examines him and permits him; he then has a son.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מאיש אחד שהיו מרננין עליו
stories.end_quote: ויהא לך בן זכר ג״כ וכך הוה
stories.summary_en: A man rumored to be forbidden to live with his wife and childless because of a defect in his organ travels to the Maggid, who has him urinate before him, then rules him permitted to his wife and promises him a son, which comes true.

tags.why: Halakhic question of marital permissibility despite a genital defect, decided by the Maggid
